2607.13565.title: UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors
2607.13565.paper_summary: We investigate which language model evasion attacks survive state-of-the-art adversarial fine-tuning, developing strategies that sweep the top 5 positions on the ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff leaderboard. While adversarial fine-tuning trivially closes the 2025 winning evasion recipes, we uncover a fundamental asymmetry in detector vulnerability: pushing generated text out of the detector's training distribution reliably defeats adversarial detection, whereas pulling it into the distribution (e.g., mimicking human training data) fails completely. Exploiting this, we introduce two novel out-of-distribution attack families - cross-decade register attacks and modernist stream-of-consciousness form. Both strategies easily bypass adversarial closure, achieving up to approximately 50x higher fool rates than previous methods while preserving naturalness. Furthermore, experiments show that the obvious deployer countermeasure (augmenting training data with period prose) fails to close the vulnerability. Our findings show that the tested detector families, including adversarially fine-tuned ones, exhibit persistent vulnerabilities under structural out-of-distribution shifts, a mechanism that directly powers our leading competition performance.
2607.13565.paper_summary_zh: 我們調查了哪些語言模型逃避攻擊能夠在最先進的對抗微調下存活，並開發出在 ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff 排行榜上佔據前 5 名的策略。雖然對抗微調輕易地關閉了 2025 年的獲勝逃避食譜，但我們發現檢測器脆弱性的一個基本不對稱性：將生成的文本推離檢測器的訓練分佈可靠地擊敗對抗檢測，而將其拉入該分佈（例如，模仿人類訓練數據）則完全失敗。利用這一點，我們引入了兩種新型的分佈外攻擊家族——跨十年的登記攻擊和現代主義意識流形式。這兩種策略輕鬆繞過對抗關閉，達到比以往方法高出約 50 倍的欺騙率，同時保持自然性。此外，實驗顯示，明顯的部署者對策（用古典散文增強訓練數據）無法關閉這一脆弱性。我們的研究結果顯示，被測試的檢測器家族，包括經過對抗微調的檢測器，在結構性分佈外變化下表現出持久的脆弱性，這一機制直接促成了我們在競爭中的領先表現。
2607.13565.author: Dima Galat et.al.
